description: This is a Python script for converting XML data models related to device management (CWMP/TR-181, TR-104, TR-135, TR-106) into JSON format. It includes functions for parsing XML, handling data types, generating JSON objects, and managing mappings, with a focus on device configuration data models.

methods.name: getname
methods.description: Determines the object name based on its hierarchical name, adjusting for specific patterns.

methods.name: getparamtype
methods.description: Infers the parameter type from its syntax definition in the XML.

methods.name: getParamDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for a parameter from its XML definition.

methods.name: getMinMaxEnumerationUnitPatternparam
methods.description: Extracts range, enumeration, unit, and pattern constraints from parameter syntax.

methods.name: getparamdatatyperef
methods.description: Resolves data type references to their detailed constraints.

methods.name: getparamlist
methods.description: Gets min/max items and max size for list-type parameters.

methods.name: getparamoption
methods.description: Gathers options and constraints for a parameter, including list info and data type details.

methods.name: generatelistfromfile
methods.description: Reads external C files to populate mapping information for list generation.

methods.name: getparammapping
methods.description: Retrieves mapping info for a parameter based on external list mapping.

methods.name: getobjmapping
methods.description: Retrieves mapping info for an object based on external list mapping.

methods.name: objhaschild
methods.description: Checks if a parent object has child objects at a certain level.

methods.name: objhasparam
methods.description: Checks if an object has parameters.

methods.name: getuniquekeys
methods.description: Extracts unique key parameters from an object.

methods.name: printopenobject
methods.description: Outputs the opening JSON syntax for an object.

methods.name: printopenfile
methods.description: Outputs the opening brace for the JSON file.

methods.name: printclosefile
methods.description: Outputs the closing brace for the JSON file.

methods.name: printOBJMaPPING
methods.description: Outputs the mapping information for an object.

methods.name: printPARAMMaPPING
methods.description: Outputs the mapping information for a parameter.

methods.name: removelastline
methods.description: Removes the last line from the temporary JSON file.

methods.name: replace_data_in_file
methods.description: Replaces specific data in the temporary JSON file.

methods.name: updatejsontmpfile
methods.description: Performs multiple replacements to format the JSON temporary file correctly.

methods.name: removetmpfiles
methods.description: Deletes temporary JSON files used during processing.

methods.name: printOBJ
methods.description: Outputs a JSON object for a device object, including description, access, and mapping info.

methods.name: printPARAM
methods.description: Outputs a JSON entry for a parameter, including type, constraints, and mapping.

methods.name: printCOMMAND
methods.description: Outputs a JSON command object with input/output parameters.

methods.name: printEVENT
methods.description: Outputs a JSON event object with parameters.

methods.name: printusage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: getobjectpointer
methods.description: Finds an object in the model by name.

methods.name: chech_each_obj_with_other_obj
methods.description: Checks and processes objects present in one model but missing in another.

methods.name: check_if_obj_exist_in_other_xml_file
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in the other model.

methods.name: chech_current_param_exist_in_other_obj
methods.description: Checks if a parameter exists in another object and determines its type.

methods.name: chech_obj_with_other_obj
methods.description: Processes parameters and commands to compare objects between models.

methods.name: object_parse_childs
methods.description: Recursively parses child objects and parameters, generating JSON output.

methods.name: generatejsonfromobj
methods.description: Main function to generate JSON data from a given object and directory.

methods.name: processDatatypes
methods.description: Processes data type definitions to extract descriptions and enumerations.

methods.name: getParamDesc
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the description of a parameter, including enumerations and expanded data types.
